# Real-client concurrency qualification

**AI disclosure:** Generated by AI. This is the executable handoff from
[#94](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/94) to
[#36](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/36).
Software results do not establish hardware success or grant a decoder lease.
The existing grudev model/overlap/TSan evidence remains separate.

## Offline preparation and identities

Use a clean, reviewed source commit and a fresh build. No installation is needed.
Record the actual commit and built files, not a branch name copied from this guide.
All paths below must be absolute; output directories must not already exist.

```sh
meson setup /absolute/build-concurrent -Db_sanitize=address,undefined
meson test -C /absolute/build-concurrent --print-errorlogs
sh tests/frame-check.sh
sh tests/shared-contexts.sh
python3 tests/concurrent-va-run.py --prepare /absolute/campaign/inputs
python3 tests/concurrent-va-run.py /absolute/build-concurrent/tests/concurrent-va-worker \
  --manifest /absolute/campaign/inputs/manifest.json \
  --output /absolute/campaign/software --repetitions 10
```

The generated manifest records exact media SHA-256, format/dimensions, eight
frames per clip, full-stream and four-frame-prefix MD5s, retained frame-4 MD5,
raw reference SHA-256, FFmpeg binary SHA-256 and recipes. H.264, HEVC and VP9
8-bit clips use public lavfi patterns. VP9 10-bit remuxes eight frames from the
existing CC0 fixture with pinned SHA-256
`cfc1d27ad161696e574020b910cd952725cf67d12e0913dedec7d202aae84463`;
this keeps older hosted libvpx builds usable. Each reference is independently
decoded with the FFmpeg CLI and hashed from packed raw pixels in Python. The
worker never supplies its own expected digest. This is independent plumbing,
not an independent codec implementation. Preserve the generated files because
encoder/container bytes may vary between versions/runs.

## Finite schedules

Ten repetitions × 1/2/4 contexts × three schedules × two execution styles =
**180 groups**, each bounded to 30 seconds plus at most five seconds of cleanup.
Each repetition rotates codec assignment, including single-context groups.
Seed `549203187 + repetition*17 + context_count` fixes bounded client pacing;
it cannot make OS scheduling deterministic or prove in-driver overlap.

- **Threads:** one shared VA device/display; each thread owns its decoder.
  All decoders rendezvous before the first packet. Normal output is eight
  frames per stream. Teardown/failure schedules rendezvous after four frames;
  stream 0 retains an actual decoded AVFrame, destroys its decoder and checks
  retained pixels again. Other live decoder contexts then resume to eight
  frames. Stream 0 must match exactly the independent four-frame prefix.
- **Processes:** 1/2/4 owned processes receive a start token after launch.
  Each owns one device/context and follows the same schedule; teardown/failure
  output is four frames for each process. This is a launch barrier, not a
  cross-process decoder midpoint barrier.
- **Failure:** on stream 0's still-live decoder, drain pending output to EOF
  and require a repeated drain request to return `AVERROR_EOF`, then perform
  retained-frame teardown. Buffered drain frames outside the selected prefix
  are deliberately discarded. This tests FFmpeg client error handling and
  survival of the other live streams. It does not inject a VA driver error or
  send malformed firmware work, and never calls through a freed context.

Every process's ID, count, digest, seed, schedule and retained-frame evidence
must match. Software fallback is rejected in hardware mode. The worker holds
an AVFrame across decoder teardown; that does not establish independently
held `VAImage`/exported-DMABUF lifetime, simultaneous driver calls during
teardown, or a resource soak. Parent #36 retains any such unfulfilled criteria.

## Guarded execution in #36 only

Before execution, claim #36, review this exact source/helper/driver/corpus plan,
read the companion AGENTS.md, establish an idle exclusive decoder window and
record kernel, loaded-module provenance and client/tool versions. The guard's
whole-boot fault check must pass; do not shorten the journal window to conceal
old faults. A claim or a nonempty lease environment variable is not a guard.

```sh
export LIBVA_DRIVERS_PATH=/absolute/build-concurrent/src
export LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=v4l2_request
export V4L2R_SOURCE_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
sha256sum /absolute/build-concurrent/src/v4l2_request_drv_video.so \
  /absolute/build-concurrent/tests/concurrent-va-worker \
  /absolute/campaign/inputs/manifest.json
python3 tests/hwguard.py --identity avd --deadline 6600 \
  --log /absolute/campaign/guard.jsonl -- \
  python3 tests/concurrent-va-run.py /absolute/build-concurrent/tests/concurrent-va-worker \
  --manifest /absolute/campaign/inputs/manifest.json \
  --output /absolute/campaign/hardware --mode vaapi --repetitions 10 --deadline 30
```

No command above installs or reloads a module. The outer guard monitors faults,
wedge/foreign holders and final idle state. Stop on the first failed group or
new hardware fault; preserve partial evidence. Do not retry, reset, force
unload, or accept remaining schedules after a fault. Group creation, decode,
output and cleanup are bounded; cancellation signals owned groups before
reaping their leaders. Real workers spawn threads, not descendants. An
explicitly detached descendant is outside process-group ownership; the
negative fixture cleans its separate identity and verifies inherited stdout
cannot hang this runner, rather than claiming global descendant containment.

`identity.json` records worker/helper/manifest/selected userspace driver hashes,
source commit and lease. Each group preserves logs and `result.json`;
`accepted.json` lists only fully validated groups; `complete.json` is written
only after all 180 pass. Keep these with the guard log, original manifest and
media. Guard success, exact output and healthy final state are all required.
The selected userspace binary hash does not certify an earlier-loaded kernel
module. Publish a normalized evidence summary with local paths redacted and
state failures, skipped work and remaining #36 criteria explicitly.
